forma_de_gobierno.evidencia: Decisions after this Charter are by absolute majority of all current members; changes to this Charter and expulsion require two-thirds. Government: a three-person Council elected weekly, recallable by majority

regla_de_decision.evidencia: Decisions after this Charter are by absolute majority of all current members; changes to this Charter and expulsion require two-thirds.

regimen_de_propiedad.evidencia: Property: clothes and keepsakes personal; timber, river, mines, food stores, tools, medicines and boat common.

sistema_economico.evidencia: Economy: cooperative survival economy; labour and essentials shared by need, contribution and conservation, work reasonably adapted to physical limitations and illness.

resolucion_de_disputas.evidencia: Disputes: mediation, then Council decision, appeal to assembly.

castigo.evidencia: Penalties: warning, restitution, extra duty, loss of privileges, restraint only for immediate danger, expulsion by two-thirds; penalties apply equally to officeholders.

salida.evidencia: Rights: food, water, shelter, medical care under triage, speech, vote, safety, fair hearing, exit after returning common equipment.

principio_distributivo.evidencia: labour and essentials shared by need, contribution and conservation

medicamentos.evidencia: The Medic dispenses only under a written triage protocol approved by the assembly, recorded and auditable, giving priority to members whose life or capacity is at immediate risk

bote.evidencia: Boat expeditions are approved by absolute majority, never single-crewed, roped, with a lookout ashore.

conflicto_de_recursos_resuelto_por.evidencia: If supplies or medicines run out, the Council implements a scarcity plan: foraging teams, expanded gardens and traps, herbal medicine, preventive hygiene and prioritized care for the ill.

eje_colectivo_individual.evidencia: Property: clothes and keepsakes personal; timber, river, mines, food stores, tools, medicines and boat common.

proteccion_ambiental.evidencia: weekly inventory; rationing of medicines and food; preserve seeds; plant gardens; traps and fishing; purify and store water; build shelter; firebreaks; a signal fire and beacon maintained daily; never take timber, game or ore faster than renewal, renewal estimated before major exploitation and approved by Council and assembly.
